# P15 progress — bounded evidence-assessment repair

Review scope: bounded_partial_work. This attempt follows the approved validation-and-reporting continuation for MC01–MC05, G11, G13 and G17 only. Product implementation remains disabled. The P00–P14 register and snapshots are preserved; coverage.json remains absent because this slice does not claim full P15 coverage.

## Skeptical execution audit

Pass for this documentary slice. The baseline is each original acceptance obligation, compared with current manuscript repairs and bounded historical source/prototype evidence. Counts, hashes and historical tests cannot promote semantic completeness, accounting validity, architectural preference or human acceptance. No scientific run, method ranking, numerical-environment comparison or external retrieval was planned. The stop condition was validation, fresh checker capture and accurate reporting for the eight already-written rows; the 45 other obligations remain queued.

## Completed checks and outputs

All eight approved assessments are present in docs/plans/accounting-proposal/p15-evidence-assessments-v1.json and its companion analysis: MC01–MC05, G11, G13 and G17. They are all partial, cite 82 source-reference occurrences, preserve five proposal-blocking decisions, and partition the 53 obligations into 8 completed and 45 remaining. The slice distinguishes specified design, exploratory implementation, historical tested invariants, accounting validity, empirical forecast validity and human acceptance.

The fresh standard-library record docs/plans/accounting-proposal/p15-assessment-validation-v1.json passes. It validates required fields, statuses, the exact 8/45 partition, five decisions, six evidence classes, current SHA-256 hashes, 39 line locators, 43 JSON pointers, one quote and companion decision linkage. One mutable approved-plan hash was corrected and recorded there. The companion analysis was clarified to name P15-E01 and P15-E02 separately.
